items.question: Trong câu "A BA doesn't need to know how to hack or how to write secure code.", từ "hack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA doesn't need to know how to hack or how to write secure code.", what does "hack" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to break into a computer system
items.explanation: hack /hæk/ (động từ): xâm nhập trái phép (máy tính). "Hack a system" = xâm nhập hệ thống; người làm việc này là "hacker". Nghĩa gốc: chặt, băm.
items.explanationEn: hack /hæk/ (verb): to break into a computer system. "Hack a system" means breaking into it; the person is a "hacker". The original sense is to chop.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA doesn't need to know how to hack or how to write secure code.", từ "secure" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA doesn't need to know how to hack or how to write secure code.", what does "secure" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: secure /sɪˈkjʊər/ (tính từ): an toàn, bảo mật. "Secure code" = mã an toàn; trái nghĩa: insecure. Danh từ: security.
items.explanationEn: secure /sɪˈkjʊər/ (adjective): protected against attacks. "Secure code" resists attacks; the opposite is "insecure" and the noun is "security".

items.question: Trong câu "But a BA does need to know how to ask the right questions — because most security vulnerabilities don't come from a dev writing insecure code, but from a requirement that never mentioned security in the first place.", từ "vulnerability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But a BA does need to know how to ask the right questions — because most security vulnerabilities don't come from a dev writing insecure code, but from a requirement that never mentioned security in the first place.", what does "vulnerability" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a weakness that can be attacked
items.explanation: vulnerability /ˌvʌl.nər.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): lỗ hổng (bảo mật). "Security vulnerabilities" = lỗ hổng bảo mật; tính từ: vulnerable (dễ bị tấn công).
items.explanationEn: vulnerability /ˌvʌl.nər.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): a weakness that can be attacked. "Security vulnerabilities" are weaknesses attackers exploit; the adjective is "vulnerable".

items.question: Trong câu "But a BA does need to know how to ask the right questions — because most security vulnerabilities don't come from a dev writing insecure code, but from a requirement that never mentioned security in the first place.", từ "mention" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But a BA does need to know how to ask the right questions — because most security vulnerabilities don't come from a dev writing insecure code, but from a requirement that never mentioned security in the first place.", what does "mention" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (động từ): đề cập, nhắc đến. "Never mentioned security" = chưa hề nhắc đến bảo mật; cũng là danh từ: a mention.
items.explanationEn: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (verb): to refer to briefly. "Never mentioned security" means it was never referred to; it is also a noun, "a mention".

items.question: Trong câu "But a BA does need to know how to ask the right questions — because most security vulnerabilities don't come from a dev writing insecure code, but from a requirement that never mentioned security in the first place.", từ "in the first place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But a BA does need to know how to ask the right questions — because most security vulnerabilities don't come from a dev writing insecure code, but from a requirement that never mentioned security in the first place.", what does "in the first place" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: as the first point in a list
items.explanation: in the first place /ɪn ðə fɜːst pleɪs/ (cụm từ): ngay từ đầu. "In the first place" = ngay từ đầu (thường nhấn mạnh nguyên nhân gốc); cũng dùng để liệt kê ý thứ nhất.
items.explanationEn: in the first place /ɪn ðə fɜːst pleɪs/ (phrase): from the very beginning. "In the first place" means from the beginning, stressing the root cause; it can also introduce a first point.

items.question: Trong câu "The requirement said to display order information to the user.", từ "display" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The requirement said to display order information to the user.", what does "display" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (động từ): hiển thị. "Display information" = hiển thị thông tin; danh từ "display" = màn hình.
items.explanationEn: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (verb): to show on a screen. "Display information" means showing it; the noun "display" is a screen.

items.question: Trong câu "Everyone assumed it meant only your own orders, but nobody wrote it down.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Everyone assumed it meant only your own orders, but nobody wrote it down.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): cho rằng, mặc định là. "Assume" = cho là đúng mà không kiểm tra; nghĩa khác: đảm nhận (assume responsibility).
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to believe without checking. "Assume" means believing without proof; another sense is taking on, as in "assume responsibility".

items.question: Trong câu "Everyone assumed it meant only your own orders, but nobody wrote it down.", từ "write down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Everyone assumed it meant only your own orders, but nobody wrote it down.", what does "write down" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to record on paper or in a file
items.explanation: write down /raɪt daʊn/ (cụm từ): ghi lại, viết ra. "Write it down" = ghi ra; yêu cầu không ghi lại rõ ràng dễ dẫn đến lỗ hổng.
items.explanationEn: write down /raɪt daʊn/ (phrase): to record on paper or in a file. "Write it down" means recording it; unwritten requirements lead to security holes.

items.question: Trong câu "This is IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) — one of the most common flaws, and it comes from a missing requirement about authorization, not from a weak dev.", từ "flaw" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) — one of the most common flaws, and it comes from a missing requirement about authorization, not from a weak dev.", what does "flaw" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: flaw /flɔː/ (danh từ): lỗi, khuyết điểm. "A security flaw" = lỗi bảo mật; đừng nhầm với "flow" (luồng).
items.explanationEn: flaw /flɔː/ (noun): a fault or weakness. "A security flaw" is a weakness; do not confuse it with "flow".

items.question: Trong câu "This is IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) — one of the most common flaws, and it comes from a missing requirement about authorization, not from a weak dev.", từ "weak" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) — one of the most common flaws, and it comes from a missing requirement about authorization, not from a weak dev.", what does "weak" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: weak /wiːk/ (tính từ): yếu kém (năng lực). "A weak dev" = dev yếu; câu này nói lỗi đến từ thiếu yêu cầu, không phải do dev kém.
items.explanationEn: weak /wiːk/ (adjective): lacking skill or ability. "A weak dev" is an unskilled one; the flaw comes from a missing requirement, not the dev.

items.question: Trong câu "This is IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) — one of the most common flaws, and it comes from a missing requirement about authorization, not from a weak dev.", từ "authorization" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) — one of the most common flaws, and it comes from a missing requirement about authorization, not from a weak dev.", what does "authorization" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authorization /ˌɔː.θər.aɪˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân quyền, cấp quyền. Authorization = được làm gì; khác authentication = bạn là ai.
items.explanationEn: authorization /ˌɔː.θər.aɪˈzeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): deciding what someone may do. Authorization decides what you may do; authentication checks who you are.

items.question: Trong câu "For every feature, a BA should ask one extra question:", từ "extra" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For every feature, a BA should ask one extra question:", what does "extra" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extra /ˈek.strə/ (tính từ): thêm, bổ sung. "One extra question" = thêm một câu hỏi; danh từ "extra" còn là diễn viên quần chúng.
items.explanationEn: extra /ˈek.strə/ (adjective): additional. "One extra question" means one more; as a noun "extra" is also a background actor.

items.question: Trong câu "If a malicious user has this feature, what harm could they do?", từ "malicious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a malicious user has this feature, what harm could they do?", what does "malicious" (adjective) mean?
options: có ý đồ xấu, độc hại
items.explanation: malicious /məˈlɪʃ.əs/ (tính từ): có ý đồ xấu, độc hại. "Malicious user/script" = người dùng/mã độc hại; từ liên quan: malware.
items.explanationEn: malicious /məˈlɪʃ.əs/ (adjective): intending to cause harm. "Malicious user" or "malicious script" means one intending harm; related word: "malware".

items.question: Trong câu "If a malicious user has this feature, what harm could they do?", từ "harm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a malicious user has this feature, what harm could they do?", what does "harm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: harm /hɑːm/ (danh từ): tác hại, thiệt hại. "Do harm" = gây hại; tính từ: harmful, harmless.
items.explanationEn: harm /hɑːm/ (noun): damage or injury. "Do harm" means cause damage; adjectives: "harmful", "harmless".

items.question: Trong câu "Not all data needs the same level of protection.", từ "level" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not all data needs the same level of protection.", what does "level" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: level /ˈlev.əl/ (danh từ): mức độ. "Level of protection" = mức độ bảo vệ; nghĩa khác: tầng nhà, màn chơi.
items.explanationEn: level /ˈlev.əl/ (noun): an amount or degree. "Level of protection" is a degree of protection; other senses are a floor or a game stage.

items.question: Trong câu "Not all data needs the same level of protection.", từ "protection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not all data needs the same level of protection.", what does "protection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: protection /prəˈtek.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự bảo vệ. "Data protection" = bảo vệ dữ liệu; động từ: protect.
items.explanationEn: protection /prəˈtek.ʃən/ (noun): keeping safe from harm. "Data protection" means keeping data safe; the verb is "protect".

items.question: Trong câu "A BA needs to classify it:", từ "classify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA needs to classify it:", what does "classify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. "Classify data" = phân loại dữ liệu theo mức nhạy cảm; danh từ: classification.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæs.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to sort into groups. "Classify data" means sorting it by sensitivity; the noun is "classification".

items.question: Trong câu "No risk if exposed:", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No risk if exposed:", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Data is exposed" = dữ liệu bị lộ; danh từ: exposure.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to make visible to others. "Data is exposed" means others can see it; the noun is "exposure".

items.question: Trong câu "Should not leak outside, but not a disaster:", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Should not leak outside, but not a disaster:", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): bị rò rỉ ra ngoài. "Data leaks" = rò rỉ dữ liệu; "memory leak" = rò rỉ bộ nhớ; nghĩa gốc: nước rỉ ra.
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to escape and become known. "Data leaks" means it gets out; "memory leak" is related; the basic sense is liquid escaping.

items.question: Trong câu "Should not leak outside, but not a disaster:", từ "disaster" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Should not leak outside, but not a disaster:", what does "disaster" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disaster /dɪˈzɑː.stər/ (danh từ): thảm họa. "Not a disaster" = chưa phải thảm họa; "disaster recovery" = khôi phục sau thảm họa.
items.explanationEn: disaster /dɪˈzɑː.stər/ (noun): a very bad event. "Not a disaster" means not extremely bad; "disaster recovery" restores systems after one.

items.question: Trong câu "Exposure causes serious harm:", từ "exposure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exposure causes serious harm:", what does "exposure" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the light let in for a photo
items.explanation: exposure /ɪkˈspəʊ.ʒər/ (danh từ): sự bị lộ (dữ liệu). "Data exposure" = dữ liệu bị lộ; nghĩa khác trong nhiếp ảnh: độ phơi sáng.
items.explanationEn: exposure /ɪkˈspəʊ.ʒər/ (noun): being revealed to others. "Data exposure" is data being revealed; in photography it means the light reaching the film.

items.question: Trong câu "Exposure causes serious harm:", từ "serious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exposure causes serious harm:", what does "serious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: serious /ˈsɪə.ri.əs/ (tính từ): nghiêm trọng. "Serious harm" = tác hại nghiêm trọng; với người: "a serious person" = người nghiêm túc.
items.explanationEn: serious /ˈsɪə.ri.əs/ (adjective): severe, very bad. "Serious harm" means severe damage; for people, "serious" means earnest.

items.question: Trong câu "PII (Personally Identifiable Information): full name, date of birth, address, email", từ "identifiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "PII (Personally Identifiable Information): full name, date of birth, address, email", what does "identifiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: identifiable /aɪˌden.tɪˈfaɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể nhận dạng. "Personally identifiable information" = thông tin nhận dạng cá nhân; động từ: identify.
items.explanationEn: identifiable /aɪˌden.tɪˈfaɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be recognized. "Personally identifiable information" can identify a person; the verb is "identify".

items.question: Trong câu "Financial information: account number, transaction history", từ "financial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Financial information: account number, transaction history", what does "financial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: financial /faɪˈnæn.ʃəl/ (tính từ): thuộc tài chính. "Financial information" = thông tin tài chính (số tài khoản, lịch sử giao dịch).
items.explanationEn: financial /faɪˈnæn.ʃəl/ (adjective): relating to money. "Financial information" covers money data such as account numbers and transactions.

items.question: Trong câu "Exposure is a catastrophe:", từ "catastrophe" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exposure is a catastrophe:", what does "catastrophe" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: catastrophe /kəˈtæs.trə.fi/ (danh từ): thảm họa lớn. "A catastrophe" mạnh hơn "a disaster"; tính từ: catastrophic.
items.explanationEn: catastrophe /kəˈtæs.trə.fi/ (noun): a huge disaster. "A catastrophe" is stronger than "a disaster"; the adjective is "catastrophic".

items.question: Trong câu "These are things that are never allowed, not even "temporarily":", từ "temporarily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are things that are never allowed, not even "temporarily":", what does "temporarily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: temporarily /ˈtem.pər.er.əl.i/ (trạng từ): tạm thời. Ngoặc kép quanh "temporarily" ám chỉ lý do "tạm thời" hay bị lạm dụng; tính từ: temporary.
items.explanationEn: temporarily /ˈtem.pər.er.əl.i/ (adverb): for a short time. The quotes around "temporarily" mock a common excuse; the adjective is "temporary".

items.question: Trong câu "Privacy by Design is the principle of building privacy into the system from the start, not adding it later.", từ "principle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Privacy by Design is the principle of building privacy into the system from the start, not adding it later.", what does "principle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (danh từ): nguyên tắc. Đừng nhầm "principle" (nguyên tắc) với "principal" (hiệu trưởng, chính); hai từ đọc giống nhau.
items.explanationEn: principle /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (noun): a basic rule or belief. Do not confuse "principle" (rule) with "principal" (head of a school); they sound the same.

items.question: Trong câu "Privacy by Design is the principle of building privacy into the system from the start, not adding it later.", từ "privacy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Privacy by Design is the principle of building privacy into the system from the start, not adding it later.", what does "privacy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: privacy /ˈprɪv.ə.si/ (danh từ): quyền riêng tư. "Privacy" = quyền riêng tư về dữ liệu cá nhân; tính từ: private.
items.explanationEn: privacy /ˈprɪv.ə.si/ (noun): control over personal information. "Privacy" is control over personal data; the adjective is "private".

items.question: Trong câu "Think about privacy before problems arise, not after", từ "arise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Think about privacy before problems arise, not after", what does "arise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arise /əˈraɪz/ (động từ): nảy sinh, phát sinh. "Problems arise" = vấn đề nảy sinh; trang trọng hơn "come up".
items.explanationEn: arise /əˈraɪz/ (verb): to come into being. "Problems arise" means they appear; more formal than "come up".

items.question: Trong câu "Default: collect the least, share the least, retain for the shortest time", từ "collect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Default: collect the least, share the least, retain for the shortest time", what does "collect" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep objects as a hobby
items.explanation: collect /kəˈlekt/ (động từ): thu thập. "Collect data" = thu thập dữ liệu; nghĩa khác: sưu tầm, đón con.
items.explanationEn: collect /kəˈlekt/ (verb): to gather information. "Collect data" means gathering it; other senses are collecting stamps or picking up a child.

items.question: Trong câu "Default: collect the least, share the least, retain for the shortest time", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Default: collect the least, share the least, retain for the shortest time", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): lưu giữ. "Retain for the shortest time" = lưu giữ trong thời gian ngắn nhất; danh từ: retention.
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep. "Retain for the shortest time" means keeping data only briefly; the noun is "retention".

items.question: Trong câu "Privacy is not an add-on — it is part of the architecture", từ "add-on" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Privacy is not an add-on — it is part of the architecture", what does "add-on" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: add-on /ˈæd.ɒn/ (danh từ): phần gắn thêm, bổ sung. "Not an add-on" = không phải phần gắn thêm về sau mà là một phần của kiến trúc.
items.explanationEn: add-on /ˈæd.ɒn/ (noun): an extra part added later. "Not an add-on" means not an extra bolted on later, but part of the architecture.

items.question: Trong câu "Privacy is not a trade-off against features — you can have both", từ "against" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Privacy is not a trade-off against features — you can have both", what does "against" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: against /əˈɡenst/ (giới từ): đối lập với, đổi lấy. "A trade-off against features" = đánh đổi với tính năng; nghĩa khác: dựa vào (lean against).
items.explanationEn: against /əˈɡenst/ (preposition): in opposition to. "A trade-off against features" means balanced in opposition; another sense is "lean against".

items.question: Trong câu "Protect data from collection all the way to deletion", từ "all the way" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Protect data from collection all the way to deletion", what does "all the way" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: all the way /ɔːl ðə weɪ/ (cụm từ): suốt cả quá trình. "From A all the way to B" = từ A cho tới tận B.
items.explanationEn: all the way /ɔːl ðə weɪ/ (phrase): through the whole distance. "From A all the way to B" means from A right through to B.

items.question: Trong câu "Protect data from collection all the way to deletion", từ "deletion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Protect data from collection all the way to deletion", what does "deletion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deletion /dɪˈliː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự xóa bỏ. Danh từ của delete; "soft deletion" = xóa mềm.
items.explanationEn: deletion /dɪˈliː.ʃən/ (noun): the act of removing. The noun of "delete"; "soft deletion" keeps the record but marks it removed.

items.question: Trong câu "Users have the right to control their own data", từ "right" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users have the right to control their own data", what does "right" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: right /raɪt/ (danh từ): quyền (hợp pháp). "Have the right to" = có quyền; nghĩa khác: bên phải, điều đúng.
items.explanationEn: right /raɪt/ (noun): a legal entitlement. "Have the right to" means being entitled to; other senses are a direction or what is correct.

items.question: Trong câu "What are the input validation rules? (length, format, allowed characters)", từ "validation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What are the input validation rules? (length, format, allowed characters)", what does "validation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: validation /ˌvæl.ɪˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự kiểm tra hợp lệ. "Input validation" = kiểm tra dữ liệu đầu vào; động từ: validate.
items.explanationEn: validation /ˌvæl.ɪˈdeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): checking that data is correct. "Input validation" checks incoming data; the verb is "validate".

items.question: Trong câu "Is there rate limiting? (to prevent brute force, spam)", từ "prevent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there rate limiting? (to prevent brute force, spam)", what does "prevent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (động từ): ngăn chặn. "Prevent X" hoặc "prevent X from doing" = ngăn X; danh từ: prevention.
items.explanationEn: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (verb): to stop from happening. "Prevent X" or "prevent X from doing" means stopping it; the noun is "prevention".

items.question: Trong câu "Where is the file stored? (not in the webroot)", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where is the file stored? (not in the webroot)", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔːr/ (động từ): lưu trữ. "Store a file" = lưu tệp; danh từ "store" = cửa hàng.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔːr/ (verb): to keep for later. "Store a file" means keeping it; the noun "store" is a shop.

items.question: Trong câu "Is virus/malware scanning done?", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is virus/malware scanning done?", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): quét kiểm tra. "Virus scanning" = quét virus; nghĩa khác: đọc lướt (scan a page), quét tài liệu.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to check for threats. "Virus scanning" checks files for malware; other senses are reading quickly or digitizing a page.

items.question: Trong câu "Does this endpoint require authentication?", từ "require" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does this endpoint require authentication?", what does "require" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: require /rɪˈkwaɪər/ (động từ): yêu cầu, đòi hỏi. "Require authentication" = đòi hỏi xác thực; danh từ: requirement.
items.explanationEn: require /rɪˈkwaɪər/ (verb): to need. "Require authentication" means needing a login; the noun is "requirement".

items.question: Trong câu "Is there idempotency? (calling twice doesn't charge twice)", từ "charge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there idempotency? (calling twice doesn't charge twice)", what does "charge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: charge /tʃɑːdʒ/ (động từ): tính tiền, trừ tiền. "Charge a card" = trừ tiền thẻ; nghĩa khác: sạc pin, buộc tội.
items.explanationEn: charge /tʃɑːdʒ/ (verb): to take payment. "Charge a card" means taking payment; other senses are charging a battery or accusing someone.

items.question: Trong câu "Does the refund flow need double-confirmation?", từ "refund" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does the refund flow need double-confirmation?", what does "refund" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refund /ˈriː.fʌnd/ (danh từ): sự hoàn tiền. "Refund flow" = luồng hoàn tiền; động từ: refund /rɪˈfʌnd/.
items.explanationEn: refund /ˈriː.fʌnd/ (noun): money given back. "Refund flow" is the process of returning money; the verb is stressed on the second syllable.

items.question: Trong câu "Does the email contain a link? After how long must the link expire?", từ "contain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does the email contain a link? After how long must the link expire?", what does "contain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (động từ): chứa, bao gồm. "Contain a link" = có chứa đường link; nghĩa khác: kiềm chế (contain the damage).
items.explanationEn: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (verb): to have inside. "Contain a link" means having one inside; another sense is limiting, as in "contain the damage".

items.question: Trong câu "Does the email contain a link? After how long must the link expire?", từ "expire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does the email contain a link? After how long must the link expire?", what does "expire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expire /ɪkˈspaɪər/ (động từ): hết hạn. "The link expires" = link hết hạn; danh từ: expiry, expiration.
items.explanationEn: expire /ɪkˈspaɪər/ (verb): to stop being valid. "The link expires" means it stops working; nouns: "expiry", "expiration".

items.question: Trong câu "Can the token in the link be reused?", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can the token in the link be reused?", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): dùng lại. "Be reused" = bị dùng lại; token dùng một lần thì không được reuse.
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. "Be reused" means used again; a one-time token must not be reused.

items.question: Trong câu "Does the unsubscribe flow bypass authentication?", từ "bypass" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does the unsubscribe flow bypass authentication?", what does "bypass" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bypass /ˈbaɪ.pɑːs/ (động từ): vượt qua, bỏ qua (kiểm tra). "Bypass authentication" = bỏ qua bước xác thực; danh từ "bypass" = đường vòng.
items.explanationEn: bypass /ˈbaɪ.pɑːs/ (verb): to go around a check. "Bypass authentication" means skipping the login check; the noun "bypass" is a road around a town.

items.question: Trong câu "Does the unsubscribe flow bypass authentication?", từ "unsubscribe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does the unsubscribe flow bypass authentication?", what does "unsubscribe" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: unsubscribe /ˌʌn.səbˈskraɪb/ (động từ): hủy đăng ký nhận tin. "Unsubscribe flow" = luồng hủy nhận email; trái nghĩa: subscribe.
items.explanationEn: unsubscribe /ˌʌn.səbˈskraɪb/ (verb): to stop receiving messages. "Unsubscribe flow" lets users stop emails; the opposite is "subscribe".

items.question: Trong câu "A BA needs to determine which actions to track:", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA needs to determine which actions to track:", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (động từ): xác định. "Determine which..." = xác định cái nào; tính từ "determined" = quyết tâm.
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (verb): to decide or find out. "Determine which..." means deciding exactly; the adjective "determined" means resolved.

items.question: Trong câu "GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) of the EU affects any product that has EU users.", từ "regulation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) of the EU affects any product that has EU users.", what does "regulation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: controlling a level such as heat
items.explanation: regulation /ˌreɡ.jəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy định, điều luật. "Data Protection Regulation" = quy định bảo vệ dữ liệu; động từ: regulate.
items.explanationEn: regulation /ˌreɡ.jəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): an official rule. "Data Protection Regulation" is an official rule; the verb is "regulate".

items.question: Trong câu "Vietnam also now has Decree 13/2023 on the protection of personal data.", từ "decree" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vietnam also now has Decree 13/2023 on the protection of personal data.", what does "decree" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: decree /dɪˈkriː/ (danh từ): nghị định. "Decree 13/2023" = Nghị định 13/2023; đừng nhầm với "degree" (bằng cấp).
items.explanationEn: decree /dɪˈkriː/ (noun): an official government order. "Decree 13/2023" is a government order; do not confuse it with "degree".

items.question: Trong câu "Vietnam also now has Decree 13/2023 on the protection of personal data.", từ "personal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vietnam also now has Decree 13/2023 on the protection of personal data.", what does "personal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: personal /ˈpɜː.sən.əl/ (tính từ): cá nhân. "Personal data" = dữ liệu cá nhân; đừng nhầm với "personnel" (nhân sự).
items.explanationEn: personal /ˈpɜː.sən.əl/ (adjective): belonging to one person. "Personal data" belongs to an individual; do not confuse it with "personnel" (staff).

items.question: Trong câu "Use this when reviewing requirements or before writing ACs:", từ "review" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use this when reviewing requirements or before writing ACs:", what does "review" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: review /rɪˈvjuː/ (động từ): xem xét, rà soát. "Review requirements" = rà soát yêu cầu; nghĩa khác: viết bài đánh giá, ôn tập.
items.explanationEn: review /rɪˈvjuː/ (verb): to examine carefully. "Review requirements" means examining them; other senses are writing a critique or revising.

items.question: Trong câu "Not just deactivating the account — it must be truly deleted", từ "deactivate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not just deactivating the account — it must be truly deleted", what does "deactivate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deactivate /diˈæk.tɪ.veɪt/ (động từ): vô hiệu hóa. Deactivate chỉ tắt tài khoản, dữ liệu vẫn còn; GDPR yêu cầu xóa thật.
items.explanationEn: deactivate /diˈæk.tɪ.veɪt/ (verb): to turn off. Deactivating only switches an account off and keeps the data; GDPR requires real deletion.

items.question: Trong câu "Users can opt out of marketing email, analytics tracking", từ "opt out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users can opt out of marketing email, analytics tracking", what does "opt out" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to choose not to take part
to sign up to take part
items.explanation: opt out /ɒpt aʊt/ (cụm từ): chọn không tham gia. "Opt out of" = chọn rút khỏi; trái nghĩa: "opt in" (chọn tham gia).
items.explanationEn: opt out /ɒpt aʊt/ (phrase): to choose not to take part. "Opt out of" means choosing not to take part; the opposite is "opt in".

items.question: Trong câu "Is explicit consent required?", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is explicit consent required?", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, minh thị. "Explicit consent" = đồng ý rõ ràng (tự tay tick); trái nghĩa: implicit.
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. "Explicit consent" is clearly given, e.g. ticking a box; the opposite is "implicit".

items.question: Trong câu "Is explicit consent required?", từ "consent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is explicit consent required?", what does "consent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consent /kənˈsent/ (danh từ): sự đồng ý. "Give/withdraw consent" = đồng ý/rút lại sự đồng ý; cũng là động từ: consent to.
items.explanationEn: consent /kənˈsent/ (noun): permission or agreement. "Give consent" or "withdraw consent"; it is also a verb, "consent to".

items.question: Trong câu "Can users withdraw consent? What is the flow?", từ "withdraw" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can users withdraw consent? What is the flow?", what does "withdraw" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: withdraw /wɪðˈdrɔː/ (động từ): rút lại. "Withdraw consent" = rút lại sự đồng ý; nghĩa khác: rút tiền (withdraw money).
items.explanationEn: withdraw /wɪðˈdrɔː/ (verb): to take back. "Withdraw consent" means taking it back; another sense is "withdraw money".

items.question: Trong câu "Is consent obtained in the right place?", từ "obtain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is consent obtained in the right place?", what does "obtain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: obtain /əbˈteɪn/ (động từ): có được, lấy được. "Obtain consent" = xin được sự đồng ý; trang trọng hơn "get".
items.explanationEn: obtain /əbˈteɪn/ (verb): to get. "Obtain consent" means getting it; more formal than "get".

items.question: Trong câu "The best security mindset is "Assume breach" — assume the system will be attacked, and design to minimize damage when that happens.", từ "breach" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best security mindset is "Assume breach" — assume the system will be attacked, and design to minimize damage when that happens.", what does "breach" (noun) mean?
options: sự xâm phạm, vụ rò rỉ
optionsEn: a failure to keep an agreement
items.explanation: breach /briːtʃ/ (danh từ): sự xâm phạm, vụ rò rỉ. "Data breach" = vụ lộ dữ liệu; nghĩa khác: vi phạm (breach of contract).
items.explanationEn: breach /briːtʃ/ (noun): a break-in to a system. "Data breach" is a security break-in; another sense is "breach of contract".

items.question: Trong câu "The best security mindset is "Assume breach" — assume the system will be attacked, and design to minimize damage when that happens.", từ "minimize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best security mindset is "Assume breach" — assume the system will be attacked, and design to minimize damage when that happens.", what does "minimize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: minimize /ˈmɪn.ɪ.maɪz/ (động từ): giảm thiểu. "Minimize damage" = giảm thiểu thiệt hại; nghĩa khác: thu nhỏ cửa sổ.
items.explanationEn: minimize /ˈmɪn.ɪ.maɪz/ (verb): to reduce to the least. "Minimize damage" means reducing it as much as possible; it also means shrinking a window.

items.question: Trong câu "If one account is compromised, what can the attacker do?", từ "compromise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If one account is compromised, what can the attacker do?", what does "compromise" (verb) mean?
options: bị xâm nhập, bị chiếm quyền
optionsEn: to be taken over by an attacker
items.explanation: compromise /ˈkɒm.prə.maɪz/ (động từ): bị xâm nhập, bị chiếm quyền. "An account is compromised" = tài khoản bị chiếm; nghĩa khác: thỏa hiệp.
items.explanationEn: compromise /ˈkɒm.prə.maɪz/ (verb): to be taken over by an attacker. "An account is compromised" means an attacker controls it; another sense is reaching a middle ground.

items.question: Trong câu "Emails and names exposed → spam, phishing → bad but manageable", từ "manageable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Emails and names exposed → spam, phishing → bad but manageable", what does "manageable" (adjective) mean?
options: xử lý được, kiểm soát được
items.explanation: manageable /ˈmæn.ɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): xử lý được, kiểm soát được. "Bad but manageable" = tệ nhưng vẫn xử lý được; động từ: manage.
items.explanationEn: manageable /ˈmæn.ɪ.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be dealt with. "Bad but manageable" means unpleasant but under control; the verb is "manage".

items.question: Trong câu "Can escalate to admin → catastrophe (privilege escalation)", từ "escalate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Can escalate to admin → catastrophe (privilege escalation)", what does "escalate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to raise to a higher level of access
items.explanation: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (động từ): leo thang (quyền). "Privilege escalation" = leo thang quyền; nghĩa khác: báo lên cấp trên (escalate an issue).
items.explanationEn: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (verb): to raise to a higher level of access. "Privilege escalation" means gaining higher access; another sense is "escalate an issue" to a manager.

items.question: Trong câu "Designing with this mindset helps a BA ask the right security questions right from the requirement stage, instead of discovering vulnerabilities after launch.", từ "stage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Designing with this mindset helps a BA ask the right security questions right from the requirement stage, instead of discovering vulnerabilities after launch.", what does "stage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stage /steɪdʒ/ (danh từ): giai đoạn. "Requirement stage" = giai đoạn thu thập yêu cầu; nghĩa khác: sân khấu.
items.explanationEn: stage /steɪdʒ/ (noun): a phase in a process. "Requirement stage" is the phase of defining requirements; another sense is a theatre platform.
